name: nightshift
description: Coverage-driven, budget-aware assurance loop with two lanes — /nightshift:security (security review + mandatory refuter) and /nightshift:design (designer/UX). v3 runs local-first behind one easy button (`ns run <repo> <lane>`): a deterministic TypeScript core owns every checkable behavior, a conditional-free dynamic Workflow fans out reviewer+refuter per surface, every run's real cost is recorded, and one self-contained local HTML dashboard is regenerated on every exit path. Built once as an engine; each codebase onboarded as a .nightshift/ pack.
